narr: An active storm pattern as several mid-level shortwaves crossed the region. An MCV lifted east northeast out of the Ozarks across southern Arkansas. The MCV fired up morning convection across the Mid-South with isolated storm coverage in the afternoon. A weak capped environment was broken and steep mid-level lapse rates, roughly 30 knots of shear, and plentiful instability allowed storms to flourish to the south. High Precipitable Water values and training storms resulted in several instances of flash flooding across West Tennessee resulting in evacuations, a stalled vehicle, and leaving several roads closed or impassable.
